rules.question: Do HTML elements use native semantic elements when available?
rules.applies_if: Web HTML layouts or interactive components

rules.question: Are all interactive features operable via keyboard?
Is the focus indicator clearly visible?
rules.applies_if: CSS styles or components with focused states

rules.question: Is focus prevented from being obscured?
rules.applies_if: Sticky elements, modals, or overlapping layers

rules.question: Do dialogs manage initial focus capture and return focus on close?
Do form inputs have associated labels?
Are form validation errors announced to assistive technology?
Do informative images feature appropriate alt text?
Are decorative images hidden from assistive technology output?
rules.applies_if: Decorative img tags or icons (alt='', aria-hidden)

rules.question: Does page structure utilize consistent heading hierarchy and landmarks?
Are color contrast and UI states conveyed without relying on color alone?
rules.applies_if: UI component design and visual styling

rules.question: Do interactive touch targets meet minimum size requirements?
Does drag-and-drop functionality offer a single-pointer alternative?
Is content free from dangerous flashing effects?
Can time limits be extended, adjusted, or turned off?
rules.applies_if: Timed sessions or visible countdown timers

rules.question: Does layout scale gracefully under page zoom and reflow?
rules.applies_if: Responsive CSS layout and text enlargement

rules.question: Do responsive viewport variations retain semantic meaning?
Are unexpected context changes prevented on input focus or value change?
rules.applies_if: onFocus or onChange handlers on form controls

rules.question: Is the authentication flow accessible to assistive technologies?
Are instructions and help elements consistent across screens?
rules.applies_if: Reused UI components or user guidance text

rules.question: Does the UI expose correct accessible names, roles, and states to screen readers?
rules.applies_if: Using ARIA attributes or custom web components

rules.question: Do animations respect the user's reduced motion preferences?
Do dates, numbers, and currencies adhere to local conventions and time zones?
rules.applies_if: Displaying formatted values in the UI

rules.question: Do RTL (Right-to-Left) or multilingual text layouts render without breaking component structure?
